test_title: PYST 06: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2
solution:
The correct answer is '**employ**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses various systems of traditional medicine and their use of natural products.
 
• The appropriate verb should be in a form that correctly describes the action of these systems of medicine using natural products.
 
• "**Employ**" fits well as it accurately describes the use of natural products by these traditional medicines.
 
• Other options ("**employing**", "**employs**", "**employed**") do not fit correctly in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Traditional medicines (TMs) make (1) use of__ natural products and are of great importance. Such forms of medicine as traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), Ayurveda, Kampo, traditional Korean medicine (TKM), and Unani (2) __employ__ natural products and have been (3) _______ all over the world for hundreds or even thousands of years, and they (4) _______ blossomed into orderly-regulated systems of medicine. In their various forms, they may have certain defects, but they (5) _______ still a valuable repository of human knowledge.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Employing: "Employing" is a present participle, which does not fit the structure of the sentence.
 
• Employs: "Employs" is in singular form, whereas the subject is plural (traditional medicines).
 
• Employed: "Employed" is a past participle, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
